back_translation: Put the ram's horn to your lips! An eagle is over the house of the LORD, because they have transgressed My covenant and rebelled against My law.
Israel cries out to Me, 'O our God, we know You!'
But Israel has rejected the good; an enemy will pursue him.
They set up kings, but not by Me; they appointed princes without My approval. With their silver and gold they made themselves idols, to their own destruction.
O Samaria, I have rejected your calf; My anger burns against them. How long will they be incapable of innocence?
For this thing is from Israel—a craftsman made it, and it is not God; the calf of Samaria will be smashed to pieces.
For they sow the wind, and they will reap the whirlwind. The standing grain has no head; what sprouts yields no flour; even if it should produce, foreigners would swallow it up.
Israel is swallowed up! Now they are among the nations like a worthless vessel.
For they have gone up to Assyria like a wild donkey wandering alone; Ephraim has hired lovers.
Though they hire allies among the nations, I will now gather them up, and they will begin to diminish under the oppression of the great king.
Though Ephraim built many altars to deal with sin, those altars became for him altars for sinning.
Though I wrote for them the many great things of My law, they regarded them as something strange.
They offer sacrifices as gifts to Me and eat the meat, but the LORD does not accept them. Now He will remember their iniquity and punish their sins; they will return to Egypt.
Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; Judah has multiplied fortified cities. But I will send fire upon their cities, and it will consume their citadels.
